# Lewis Shum

> Full Stack Software Engineer based in Toronto, building functional, secure, and scalable applications that solve real-world problems.

## About

Lewis Shum is a Toronto-based software engineer experienced in building everything from large-scale insurance platforms (2M+ worldwide users) to fast-moving startup products. He embraces AI-assisted development workflows and focuses on code quality, security, and scalability.

- Languages: TypeScript, Python, C#, Swift
- Frameworks: React, Next.js, NestJS, Node.js, Express, React Native, Expo, Tailwind CSS
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase
- DevOps: AWS (EC2, ECS, ECR, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, Secrets Manager), Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare, Vercel

## Projects

- [Trend Radar](https://trend-radar.lewisshum.com): Real-time financial dashboard ranking 12 market sectors by momentum, with candlestick charts and live data across US indices, global markets, and commodities. Stack: TypeScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Docker, GitHub Actions.
- [Drawvaltine](https://drawvaltine.com): Art portfolio site with a headless CMS giving the artist full control over content and media. Stack: Next.js, Payload CMS, PostgreSQL (Neon), Vercel Blob, Vercel.
